visual.general_description: Two stacked line charts labeled A and B, each plotting right and left GRF and cadence against session number.
visual.detailed_description: Panel A (top) spans 26 sessions with GRF rising overall and cadence in steps up to 45 steps/min; panel B (bottom) spans 14 sessions with GRF peaking at session 5, dropping at session 6 and cadence stepping from 30 to 35 to 50 steps/min. Both panels use the same title, legend, orange circles for Rt. GRF, blue squares for Lt. GRF and a dashed yellow line with triangles for cadence on a right-hand axis.

panels.general_description: Line chart of right and left GRF and cadence across 26 sessions.
panels.detailed_description: Chart titled RAGT Sessions: GRF vs. Cadence with the x-axis titled Session (ticks 1 to 26), a left y-axis titled GRF (% body weight) with ticks 70, 80, 90, 100 and 110, and a right y-axis titled Cadence (steps/min) with ticks from 25.0 to 45.0 in steps of 2.5. A legend at the upper left lists Rt. GRF (% body weight) as an orange solid line with circles, Lt. GRF (% body weight) as a blue solid line with squares and Cadence (steps/min) as a dashed yellow line with triangles. Both GRF lines rise from about 65 to 67 at session 1 to about 105 to 108 at session 26, with a dip at session 21. The dashed cadence line steps from 25 to 30, back to 25 for sessions 4 to 7, then 30 for sessions 8 to 12, 35 for sessions 13 to 18, 40 for sessions 19 to 22 and 45 for sessions 23 to 26. Faint gridlines are present; a black circle with the letter A is at the upper left.
